What goes online and which permissions exist
GPL-3.0-or-later. The source code is open.

Ruthenia Store is free software under the GNU GPL-3.0-or-later license.

The network layer is implemented independently, but builds on analysis of the open-source Obtainium project (GPL-3.0).

Trademarks belong to their respective owners. Mention of RuStore only states compatibility.

Ruthenia Store collects no analytics, shows no ads, requires no RuStore account and does not share your data with third parties. Everything that goes over the network is a request to the RuStore API itself plus a one-off download of the official Mintsifry certificates during a manual refresh in settings — both are required for search and downloads.

• backapi.rustore.ru — search, home feed, app info, developer apps, file links.
• api.rustore.ru — a one-off nonce for signing requests.
• static-m.rustore.ru and static.rustore.ru — APK downloads and icon loading.
• gu-st.ru — official Russian Trusted CA certificates (Mintsifry), only during a manual certificate refresh in settings.

There are no other network requests. You can verify this with a proxy.

Device headers (model, Android version, language, ABI), device type and a User-Agent in RuStore format. They are static and identical for every user — they cannot tell one device from another.

deviceId is random and ephemeral: it is regenerated on every launch, is not linked to the Android advertising ID and is not stored on disk.

The request signature (X-Client-Signature) is computed locally via HMAC-SHA256 and is needed by RuStore to answer protected endpoints.

The home feed is not personalised: its sections are built from fixed common queries (for example "bank", "government services"), and the "Recommended" selection comes from a predefined list of apps inside the APK. No behavioural profile is built.

The list of installed apps is read via PackageManager strictly locally and only when you tap "Find my apps in RuStore" yourself.

Only the package names of the apps being checked go over the network — one request per app to look up its catalog version. Names, icons and any other data from the installed list are never sent out and stay on the device.

Before installing an update, the downloaded APK's signature is checked against the installed app: a build from another source will not install. You can cancel the import at any time.

An update is downloaded in the background only after you tap "Update" yourself in the library\'s updates section: the app requests file links and downloads them from the RuStore CDN. Nothing is downloaded without your action — the background check only compares version numbers.\n\nDownloaded files are verified by signature by default and installed only after system confirmation. You can enable auto-install after download and disable signature verification — both are in settings; signature verification is on by default.

• INTERNET — the only network access, only to the hosts listed above.
• POST_NOTIFICATIONS — notifications about available updates and background download progress.
• REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES — installing a downloaded APK via the system PackageInstaller.
• QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES — to show the list of installed apps and their versions. Read only locally via PackageManager and never sent anywhere.

• Room database: a cache of found apps and the list of apps installed through Ruthenia Store.
• DataStore: your settings (theme, check interval, Wi-Fi).
• Temporary downloaded APK files (including background downloads) — deleted right after installation.

None of this leaves the device. App backup is disabled (allowBackup=false).

Part of RuStore\'s infrastructure uses the Russian Trusted Root/Sub CA. These public certificates are already bundled in the APK, so there is nothing to install manually. The trust applies only to rustore.ru domains, and certificate pin-hash verification runs on top of it.\n\nSettings include a manual certificate refresh: on your tap the app checks the live RuStore chains and the official Mintsifry certificates from gu-st.ru and updates the pin hashes. This never happens automatically.

• Does not use third-party analytics, crash reporting or ad SDKs.
• Does not sign in to a RuStore account and works anonymously.
• Does not personalise recommendations: the home feed is fixed queries and an app list, with no behavioural profile.
• Does not scan installed apps without your action: the import starts only from a button.
• Does not install anything without your explicit action: the system always shows its own dialog.
• Does not install an update if the downloaded file's signature does not match the installed app (verification is on by default and can only be disabled manually in settings).
• Does not log data to the internet — local diagnostics are off by default and never sent anywhere.
